title: Evidence must describe the traded bar set: test closed vs forming per leg as an IMPROVEMENT test and run whichever wins; demote only if neither passes
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-18 ~15:12Z, a refinement of the WORK above: treat this as an IMPROVEMENT test, not a demotion test. For each leg (eth_prop, xrp_pullback_2h), compare decision_bar=closed against forming net of the full cost stack, under a selection rule registered before the run. If closed beats forming, SWITCH the live builder to closed, which is a data-backed Tier-3 change. Demotion applies only if NEITHER variant clears RULE-D1. The selection rule must still require out-of-sample robustness, e.g. fold-majority. The 2026-10-18 eth_prop holdout showed closed ahead on the full history (+89 vs +75R) and on the latest 25% (+11.0 vs +1.3R), but it won only 2 of 4 discovery folds. The new unit should pre-register the comparison (a paired per-fold delta with a materiality floor) rather than reuse that rule unexamined. Item (2) above is replaced by this. [2026-10-22 ~06:40Z OPERATOR DECISION, Thursday walk-through popup, relayed by manager session_01CSwhZWiw15rVCkjsJ8Cpuh] Q: should a closed-bar backtest count as evidence for a forming-bar leg (eth_prop +9.32R closed vs -9.45R forming, PI-20261018-WCDIDFTE-0002)? Answer: "No — match the bar (Recommended)". Resolve here together with xrp_pullback_2h: switch the leg's decision bar or re-evidence it on the bar it trades.
